protocol.model_identity_limit: Mutable alias, not fixed weights or verified training cutoff
protocol.aggregation: Each month/repeat separately, equal cell average; Q9 headline-style center is median of individually fitted density means, not a nationwide headline.
protocol.intervals: 2000 paired-person resamples within month, both generations together; 4-month resampling sensitivity; seed 20261015
protocol.removed_instruction: Do not mechanically treat a past price change as your future inflation forecast.
protocol.comparison: Same parent C, category prices, assigned frequency vector, past beliefs, population and questionnaire; only explicit frequency-influence instruction differs.
protocol.primary_contrast: frequency_rule minus frequency_data on cross-section W1
protocol.candidate_gate: Primary W1 paired-person upper 95% bound < 0; center MAE and delta W1 points no worse; new scorable fraction >=99%. Local candidate screening, not overall project success.
protocol.mechanism_check: Across-person IQR, prior-position slope, rank, category-frequency associations; frequency-rule treatment is instruction increment, not total effect of the new data.
protocol.exploratory_old_C: Reuse previous C without rerun as descriptive context only; added prices/frequencies and batch differences prevent a clean total-data effect.
protocol.support: Same truth-scorable person-generations across both new arms and fixed past baselines; explicit failure coverage; no replacement sampling.
protocol.truth_isolation: Copy frozen roster/sidecar; no current answers read for sampling or prompts. Actual answers and weights confined to evaluation.
limits: Four previously inspected development periods; no independent holdout claim.
Returners with actual private past answers and retrospective synthetic P; not real-time B.
2020Q4 CE proxy for 2020-04 is retrospective, not a PIT input.
Engine seeds do not imply a seeded or deterministic API generation.
Whole-vector conditional CE Diary 2020Q4 proxy, selected supported contacts; not observed respondent shopping or representative full CE frequency distribution.
Existing Interview spending shares and Diary frequencies are from different households; no true joint person link.
No grooming frequency: relevant Diary rows not included for publication. Four categories do not cover all spending.
Parent C is an exploratory candidate, not an approved main-mechanism upgrade; frequency gains need other periods.
Public availability does not establish attention; national category changes do not equal observed store prices.
A returner conditional diagnostic using actual past answers; not recursive B or nationwide causal inference.

kernel_migration.equivalence_check: 3,741 sealed holdout rows recomputed; zero per-field difference

scorer.approximation_notice: Research approximation of the Armantier et al. (2017) Appendix C generalized-beta fit, selected on a preregistered holdout; not the official FRBNY implementation. The same algorithm scores real and simulated questionnaires; differences from official headline values are reported separately.

results.interval_scope: Conditional on four selected months; within-month person pairing preserves repeated generations; month-level sensitivity has only four clusters; not nationwide inference.
results.context_limit: Earlier C batch without the added price/frequency block; only descriptive context, not a clean incremental data effect.
